//! Items: the entity (it mirrors the migration), its relations and its label. Validation is in
//! params.rs, the queries in queries.rs; both are re-exported here (`item::find`, `item::ItemParams`).
//! Generated by `cargo offrails generate resource items name:string notes:text? count:integer big:bigint flag:boolean active:boolean? weight:decimal{8.3} price:money at:datetime day:date? code:uuid:unique meta:json?`.
//! APP: say what a item is, and cite its spec (product/features/items.md).

=== create src/models/item/params.rs
//! Item input: `ItemParams` (untrusted, all strings) → `validate()` → `NewItem` (typed).
//! Generated by `cargo offrails generate resource items name:string notes:text? count:integer big:bigint flag:boolean active:boolean? weight:decimal{8.3} price:money at:datetime day:date? code:uuid:unique meta:json?`.

use chrono::NaiveDateTime;
use sea_orm::entity::prelude::*;
use serde::Deserialize;

use super::Model;
use crate::models::Errors;

/// Untrusted input from the item form. This struct IS the permit list. All strings, so a
/// failed submit re-renders exactly what was typed.
#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, Deserialize)]
pub struct ItemParams {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub name: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub notes: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub count: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub big: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub flag: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub active: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub weight: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub price: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub at: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub day: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub code: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub meta: String,
}

/// Validated, typed values. Only `ItemParams::validate` makes one.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct NewItem {
    pub name: String,
    pub notes: Option<String>,
    pub count: i32,
    pub big: i64,
    pub flag: bool,
    pub active: Option<bool>,
    pub weight: Decimal,
    pub price_cents: i64,
    pub at: DateTimeUtc,
    pub day: Option<Date>,
    pub code: Uuid,
    pub meta: Option<Json>,
}

impl ItemParams {
    /// Rails wording: "can't be blank", "is too long (maximum is N characters)".
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<NewItem, Errors> {
        let mut errors = Errors::default();
        let name = self.name.trim();
        if name.is_empty() {
            errors.add("name", "can't be blank");
        } else if name.chars().count() > 255 {
            errors.add("name", "is too long (maximum is 255 characters)");
        }
        let notes = self.notes.trim();
        if notes.chars().count() > 100000 {
            errors.add("notes", "is too long (maximum is 100000 characters)");
        }
        let count = match self.count.trim() {
            "" => {
                errors.add("count", "can't be blank");
                0
            }
            raw => match raw.parse::<i32>().ok() {
                Some(v) => v,
                None => {
                    errors.add("count", "is not a number");
                    0
                }
            },
        };
        let big = match self.big.trim() {
            "" => {
                errors.add("big", "can't be blank");
                0
            }
            raw => match raw.parse::<i64>().ok() {
                Some(v) => v,
                None => {
                    errors.add("big", "is not a number");
                    0
                }
            },
        };
        // A checkbox sends nothing when unchecked.
        let flag = matches!(self.flag.trim(), "true" | "on" | "1");
        let active = match self.active.trim() {
            "" => None,
            "true" | "on" | "1" => Some(true),
            "false" | "off" | "0" => Some(false),
            _ => {
                errors.add("active", "is not included in the list");
                None
            }
        };
        let weight = match self.weight.trim() {
            "" => {
                errors.add("weight", "can't be blank");
                Decimal::ZERO
            }
            raw => match raw.parse::<Decimal>()
                .ok()
                .filter(|d| d.round_dp(3) == *d && d.abs() < Decimal::from(100000_i64)) {
                Some(v) => v,
                None => {
                    errors.add("weight", "is not a number with that many digits");
                    Decimal::ZERO
                }
            },
        };
        let price_cents = match self.price.trim() {
            "" => {
                errors.add("price", "can't be blank");
                0
            }
            raw => match parse_money(raw) {
                Some(v) => v,
                None => {
                    errors.add("price", "is not an amount");
                    0
                }
            },
        };
        let at = match self.at.trim() {
            "" => {
                errors.add("at", "can't be blank");
                DateTimeUtc::default()
            }
            raw => match NaiveDateTime::parse_from_str(raw, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")
                .or_else(|_| NaiveDateTime::parse_from_str(raw, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"))
                .ok()
                .map(|t| t.and_utc()) {
                Some(v) => v,
                None => {
                    errors.add("at", "is not a date and time");
                    DateTimeUtc::default()
                }
            },
        };
        let day = match self.day.trim() {
            "" => None,
            raw => match Date::parse_from_str(raw, "%Y-%m-%d").ok() {
                Some(v) => Some(v),
                None => {
                    errors.add("day", "is not a date");
                    None
                }
            },
        };
        let code = match self.code.trim() {
            "" => {
                errors.add("code", "can't be blank");
                Uuid::nil()
            }
            raw => match Uuid::parse_str(raw).ok() {
                Some(v) => v,
                None => {
                    errors.add("code", "is not a UUID");
                    Uuid::nil()
                }
            },
        };
        let meta = match self.meta.trim() {
            "" => None,
            raw => match serde_json::from_str::<Json>(raw).ok() {
                Some(v) => Some(v),
                None => {
                    errors.add("meta", "is not valid JSON");
                    None
                }
            },
        };
        errors.into_result(|| NewItem {
            name: name.to_owned(),
            notes: (!notes.is_empty()).then(|| notes.to_owned()),
            count,
            big,
            flag,
            active,
            weight,
            price_cents,
            at,
            day,
            code,
            meta,
        })
    }
}

/// Prefills the edit form.
impl From<&Model> for ItemParams {
    fn from(r: &Model) -> Self {
        Self {
            name: r.name.clone(),
            notes: r.notes.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
            count: r.count.to_string(),
            big: r.big.to_string(),
            flag: if r.flag { "true".into() } else { String::new() },
            active: r.active.map(|b| b.to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
            weight: r.weight.round_dp(3).to_string(),
            price: money_to_string(r.price_cents),
            at: r.at.format("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M").to_string(),
            day: r.day.map(|d| d.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
            code: r.code.to_string(),
            meta: r.meta.as_ref().map(|v| v.to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
        }
    }
}

/// `"12.30"` → `1230` cents; at most two decimals, an optional `-`. `None`: not an amount.
pub fn parse_money(raw: &str) -> Option<i64> {
    let raw = raw.trim().replace(',', "");
    let (negative, digits) = match raw.strip_prefix('-') {
        Some(rest) => (true, rest.to_owned()),
        None => (false, raw),
    };
    let (whole, frac) = digits.split_once('.').unwrap_or((&digits, ""));
    let ok = |s: &str| s.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit());
    if whole.is_empty() && frac.is_empty() || !ok(whole) || !ok(frac) || frac.len() > 2 {
        return None;
    }
    let whole: i64 = if whole.is_empty() { 0 } else { whole.parse().ok()? };
    let frac: i64 = format!("{frac:0<2}").parse().ok()?;
    let cents = whole.checked_mul(100)?.checked_add(frac)?;
    Some(if negative { -cents } else { cents })
}

/// `1230` cents → `"12.30"`.
pub fn money_to_string(cents: i64) -> String {
    let sign = if cents < 0 { "-" } else { "" };
    let abs = cents.unsigned_abs();
    format!("{sign}{}.{:02}", abs / 100, abs % 100)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn valid() -> ItemParams {
        ItemParams {
            name: "Name".into(),
            notes: "Notes text".into(),
            count: "42".into(),
            big: "42".into(),
            flag: "true".into(),
            active: "true".into(),
            weight: "12.555".into(),
            price: "19.99".into(),
            at: "2026-01-15T09:30".into(),
            day: "2026-01-15".into(),
            code: "67e55044-10b1-426f-9247-bb680e5fe0c8".into(),
            meta: r#"{"key": "value"}"#.into(),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn valid_params_validate() {
        assert!(valid().validate().is_ok(), "{:?}", valid().validate());
    }

    #[test]
    fn required_fields_cant_be_blank() {
        let errors = ItemParams::default().validate().unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(errors.on("name"), ["can't be blank"]);
        assert_eq!(errors.on("count"), ["can't be blank"]);
        assert_eq!(errors.on("big"), ["can't be blank"]);
        assert_eq!(errors.on("weight"), ["can't be blank"]);
        assert_eq!(errors.on("price"), ["can't be blank"]);
        assert_eq!(errors.on("at"), ["can't be blank"]);
        assert_eq!(errors.on("code"), ["can't be blank"]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn strings_have_a_maximum_length() {
        let at_max = ItemParams {
            name: "x".repeat(255),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert!(at_max.validate().is_ok());
        let over = ItemParams {
            name: "x".repeat(256),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert_eq!(
            over.validate().unwrap_err().on("name"),
            ["is too long (maximum is 255 characters)"]
        );
        let at_max = ItemParams {
            notes: "x".repeat(100000),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert!(at_max.validate().is_ok());
        let over = ItemParams {
            notes: "x".repeat(100001),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert_eq!(
            over.validate().unwrap_err().on("notes"),
            ["is too long (maximum is 100000 characters)"]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn typed_fields_reject_garbage() {
        let bad = ItemParams {
            count: "twelve".into(),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert_eq!(bad.validate().unwrap_err().on("count"), ["is not a number"]);
        let bad = ItemParams {
            big: "twelve".into(),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert_eq!(bad.validate().unwrap_err().on("big"), ["is not a number"]);
        let bad = ItemParams {
            weight: "1.2.3".into(),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert_eq!(bad.validate().unwrap_err().on("weight"), ["is not a number with that many digits"]);
        let bad = ItemParams {
            price: "12.345".into(),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert_eq!(bad.validate().unwrap_err().on("price"), ["is not an amount"]);
        let bad = ItemParams {
            at: "yesterday".into(),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert_eq!(bad.validate().unwrap_err().on("at"), ["is not a date and time"]);
        let bad = ItemParams {
            day: "2026-02-30".into(),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert_eq!(bad.validate().unwrap_err().on("day"), ["is not a date"]);
        let bad = ItemParams {
            code: "not-a-uuid".into(),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert_eq!(bad.validate().unwrap_err().on("code"), ["is not a UUID"]);
        let bad = ItemParams {
            meta: "{oops".into(),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert_eq!(bad.validate().unwrap_err().on("meta"), ["is not valid JSON"]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn money_round_trips_as_cents() {
        assert_eq!(parse_money("12"), Some(1200));
        assert_eq!(parse_money("12.3"), Some(1230));
        assert_eq!(parse_money("-0.05"), Some(-5));
        assert_eq!(parse_money("1.234"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_money("abc"), None);
        assert_eq!(money_to_string(1230), "12.30");
        assert_eq!(money_to_string(-5), "-0.05");
    }

}

=== create src/models/item/queries.rs
//! Items queries. Generated by `cargo offrails generate resource items name:string notes:text? count:integer big:bigint flag:boolean active:boolean? weight:decimal{8.3} price:money at:datetime day:date? code:uuid:unique meta:json?`.

use chrono::Utc;
use sea_orm::{ActiveValue::Set, QueryOrder, QuerySelect, entity::prelude::*};

use super::{ActiveModel, Column, Entity, Model, NewItem};
use crate::error::AppError;
use crate::models::{Errors, Page};

/// Public: anyone may read any item (`--public`; .offrails/guides/models.md#scoped-lookups-tenancy).
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(id))]
pub async fn find(db: &impl ConnectionTrait, id: i64) -> Result<Model, AppError> {
    Entity::find_by_id(id).one(db).await?.ok_or(AppError::NotFound)
}

/// A page of items, newest first, and whether there's another page.
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn all(db: &impl ConnectionTrait, page: Page) -> Result<(Vec<Model>, bool), AppError> {
    let per = page.per();
    let mut rows = Entity::find()
        .order_by_desc(Column::CreatedAt)
        .order_by_desc(Column::Id)
        .limit(per + 1)
        .offset(page.offset())
        .all(db)
        .await?;
    let more = rows.len() as u64 > per;
    rows.truncate(per as usize);
    Ok((rows, more))
}

/// Items for a `<select>`: (id, label), at most 200, by label.
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn choices(db: &impl ConnectionTrait) -> Result<Vec<(i64, String)>, AppError> {
    let rows = Entity::find().order_by_desc(Column::Id).limit(200).all(db).await?;
    let mut out: Vec<(i64, String)> = rows.iter().map(|r| (r.id, r.label())).collect();
    out.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.cmp(&b.1));
    Ok(out)
}

/// A unique index said no: a validation error on its field, not a 500
/// (.offrails/guides/models.md#validations).
fn map_unique(e: DbErr) -> AppError {
    if let Some(sea_orm::SqlErr::UniqueConstraintViolation(msg)) = e.sql_err() {
        if msg.contains("items_code_key") || msg.contains("items.code") {
            return AppError::Invalid(Errors::single("code", "has already been taken"));
        }
        return AppError::Invalid(Errors::single("base", "has already been taken"));
    }
    e.into()
}

#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn create(db: &impl ConnectionTrait, new: NewItem) -> Result<Model, AppError> {
    let now = Utc::now();
    ActiveModel {
        name: Set(new.name),
        notes: Set(new.notes),
        count: Set(new.count),
        big: Set(new.big),
        flag: Set(new.flag),
        active: Set(new.active),
        weight: Set(new.weight),
        price_cents: Set(new.price_cents),
        at: Set(new.at),
        day: Set(new.day),
        code: Set(new.code),
        meta: Set(new.meta),
        created_at: Set(now),
        updated_at: Set(now),
        ..Default::default()
    }
    .insert(db)
    .await
    .map_err(map_unique)
}

#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(id = record.id))]
pub async fn update(db: &impl ConnectionTrait, record: Model, new: NewItem) -> Result<Model, AppError> {
    let mut am: ActiveModel = record.into();
    am.name = Set(new.name);
    am.notes = Set(new.notes);
    am.count = Set(new.count);
    am.big = Set(new.big);
    am.flag = Set(new.flag);
    am.active = Set(new.active);
    am.weight = Set(new.weight);
    am.price_cents = Set(new.price_cents);
    am.at = Set(new.at);
    am.day = Set(new.day);
    am.code = Set(new.code);
    am.meta = Set(new.meta);
    am.updated_at = Set(Utc::now());
    am.update(db).await.map_err(map_unique)
}

#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(id = record.id))]
pub async fn destroy(db: &impl ConnectionTrait, record: Model) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    Entity::delete_by_id(record.id).exec(db).await?;
    Ok(())
}

=== create tests/app/factories/item.rs
//! Items test data (.offrails/guides/testing.md#factories-testsappfactoriesrs): valid params
//! through `validate` + `create`, so a test can't build an invalid row. Generated by `cargo offrails generate resource items name:string notes:text? count:integer big:bigint flag:boolean active:boolean? weight:decimal{8.3} price:money at:datetime day:date? code:uuid:unique meta:json?`.

/// Valid ItemParams (unique values numbered), for forms and `item_with`.
pub async fn item_params(db: &sea_orm::DatabaseConnection) -> offrails_app::models::item::ItemParams {
    let _ = db; // no parent records to create
    static N: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize = std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(1);
    let n = N.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    offrails_app::models::item::ItemParams {
        name: format!("Name {n}"),
        notes: format!("Notes {n}, long enough to read."),
        count: "42".into(),
        big: "42".into(),
        flag: "true".into(),
        active: "true".into(),
        weight: "12.555".into(),
        price: "19.99".into(),
        at: "2026-01-15T09:30".into(),
        day: "2026-01-15".into(),
        code: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
        meta: r#"{"key": "value"}"#.into(),
    }
}

/// A item, through `ItemParams::validate` + `item::create`.
pub async fn item(db: &sea_orm::DatabaseConnection) -> offrails_app::models::item::Model {
    let params = item_params(db).await;
    item_with(db, params).await
}

/// A item from these params (they must be valid).
pub async fn item_with(
    db: &sea_orm::DatabaseConnection,
    params: offrails_app::models::item::ItemParams,
) -> offrails_app::models::item::Model {
    let new = params.validate().expect("valid item params");
    offrails_app::models::item::create(db, new).await.expect("create item")
}

/// Reads a item back through the entity (tests can't call the model-private `find`).
pub async fn reload_item(db: &sea_orm::DatabaseConnection, id: i64) -> Option<offrails_app::models::item::Model> {
    use sea_orm::EntityTrait;
    offrails_app::models::item::Entity::find_by_id(id)
        .one(db)
        .await
        .expect("reload item")
}

=== create tests/app/models/item_test.rs
//! `item` (src/models/item/) against the database: ordering, paging, uniqueness.
//! Generated by `cargo offrails generate resource items name:string notes:text? count:integer big:bigint flag:boolean active:boolean? weight:decimal{8.3} price:money at:datetime day:date? code:uuid:unique meta:json?`.

use offrails_app::error::AppError;
use offrails_app::models::{Page, item};

use crate::factories;
use crate::support::TestApp;

#[tokio::test]
async fn all_pages_newest_first() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let first = factories::item(app.db()).await;
    let second = factories::item(app.db()).await;
    let third = factories::item(app.db()).await;
    let (rows, more) = item::all(app.db(), Page::new(1, 2)).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(rows, vec![third, second]);
    assert!(more);
    let (rows, more) = item::all(app.db(), Page::new(2, 2)).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(rows, vec![first]);
    assert!(!more);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn update_and_destroy() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let record = factories::item(app.db()).await;
    let new = factories::item_params(app.db()).await.validate().unwrap();
    let updated = item::update(app.db(), record.clone(), new).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(updated.id, record.id);
    item::destroy(app.db(), updated).await.unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(item::find(app.db(), record.id).await, Err(AppError::NotFound)));
}

/// The edit form shows what was saved: params from a record validate back to it.
#[tokio::test]
async fn the_edit_form_round_trips_a_saved_item() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let record = factories::item(app.db()).await;
    let new = item::ItemParams::from(&record).validate().unwrap();
    let saved = item::update(app.db(), record.clone(), new).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        item::Model {
            updated_at: record.updated_at,
            ..saved
        },
        record
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_duplicate_code_is_a_validation_error() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let taken = factories::item(app.db()).await;
    let mut params = factories::item_params(app.db()).await;
    params.code = taken.code.to_string();
    let new = params.validate().unwrap();
    match item::create(app.db(), new).await {
        Err(AppError::Invalid(errors)) => assert_eq!(errors.on("code"), ["has already been taken"]),
        other => panic!("expected a validation error, got {other:?}"),
    }
}

//! action pair. Generated by `cargo offrails generate resource items name:string notes:text? count:integer big:bigint flag:boolean active:boolean? weight:decimal{8.3} price:money at:datetime day:date? code:uuid:unique meta:json?`.

=== create src/controllers/items/index.rs
//! `GET /items`: a page of items, newest first.

use axum::{
    extract::State,
    response::{IntoResponse, Response},
};

use crate::{
    error::AppError,
    models::{Page, item},
    state::AppState,
    views::{
        self, Ctx,
        items::{ItemView, ItemsIndex},
    },
};

/// `GET /items`
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn index(
    State(s): State<AppState>,
    ctx: Ctx,
    page: Page,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    let (rows, more) = item::all(&s.db, page).await?;
    Ok(views::render(ItemsIndex {
        ctx: ctx.titled("Items"),
        items: rows.iter().map(ItemView::from_model).collect(),
        page: page.number(),
        more,
    })?
    .into_response())
}

=== create src/controllers/items/show.rs
//! `GET /items/{id}`: one item.

use axum::{
    extract::{Path, State},
    response::{IntoResponse, Response},
};

use crate::{
    error::AppError,
    models::item,
    state::AppState,
    views::{
        self, Ctx,
        items::{ItemView, ItemsShow},
    },
};

/// `GET /items/{id}`
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn show(
    State(s): State<AppState>,
    ctx: Ctx,
    Path(id): Path<i64>,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    let record = item::find(&s.db, id).await?;
    Ok(views::render(ItemsShow {
        ctx: ctx.titled(&record.label()),
        item: ItemView::from_model(&record),
    })?
    .into_response())
}

=== create src/controllers/items/new.rs
//! `GET /items/new` and `POST /items`: the form, and creating a item.

use axum::{
    Form,
    extract::State,
    http::StatusCode,
    response::{IntoResponse, Redirect, Response},
};

use crate::{
    error::AppError,
    kernel::flash::Flash,
    models::{Errors, item, item::ItemParams},
    routes::paths,
    state::AppState,
    views::{
        self, Ctx,
        items::ItemsNew,
    },
};

/// `GET /items/new`
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn new(
    ctx: Ctx,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    Ok(views::render(ItemsNew {
        ctx: ctx.titled("New item"),
        params: ItemParams::default(),
        errors: Errors::default(),
        action: paths::items(),
    })?
    .into_response())
}

/// `POST /items`: 303 to the new item, or the form again with 422 and the errors.
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn create(
    State(s): State<AppState>,
    ctx: Ctx,
    Form(params): Form<ItemParams>,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    let result = match params.validate() {
        Ok(new) => item::create(&s.db, new).await,
        Err(errors) => Err(AppError::Invalid(errors)),
    };
    match result {
        Ok(record) => Ok((
            Flash::notice("Item was successfully created."),
            Redirect::to(&paths::item(record.id)),
        )
            .into_response()),
        Err(AppError::Invalid(errors)) => Ok((
            StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            views::render(ItemsNew {
                ctx: ctx.titled("New item"),
                params,
                errors,
                action: paths::items(),
                })?,
        )
            .into_response()),
        Err(e) => Err(e),
    }
}

=== create src/controllers/items/edit.rs
//! `GET /items/{id}/edit` and `POST /items/{id}`: the form, and saving changes to a item.

use axum::{
    Form,
    extract::{Path, State},
    http::StatusCode,
    response::{IntoResponse, Redirect, Response},
};

use crate::{
    error::AppError,
    kernel::flash::Flash,
    models::{Errors, item, item::ItemParams},
    routes::paths,
    state::AppState,
    views::{
        self, Ctx,
        items::ItemsEdit,
    },
};

/// `GET /items/{id}/edit`
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn edit(
    State(s): State<AppState>,
    ctx: Ctx,
    Path(id): Path<i64>,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    let record = item::find(&s.db, id).await?;
    Ok(views::render(ItemsEdit {
        ctx: ctx.titled(&format!("Edit {}", record.label())),
        id: record.id,
        params: ItemParams::from(&record),
        errors: Errors::default(),
        action: paths::item(record.id),
    })?
    .into_response())
}

/// `POST /items/{id}`: 303 to the item, or the form again with 422 and the errors.
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn update(
    State(s): State<AppState>,
    ctx: Ctx,
    Path(id): Path<i64>,
    Form(params): Form<ItemParams>,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    let record = item::find(&s.db, id).await?;
    let result = match params.validate() {
        Ok(new) => item::update(&s.db, record, new).await,
        Err(errors) => Err(AppError::Invalid(errors)),
    };
    match result {
        Ok(record) => Ok((
            Flash::notice("Item was successfully updated."),
            Redirect::to(&paths::item(record.id)),
        )
            .into_response()),
        Err(AppError::Invalid(errors)) => Ok((
            StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            views::render(ItemsEdit {
                ctx: ctx.titled("Edit item"),
                id,
                params,
                errors,
                action: paths::item(id),
                })?,
        )
            .into_response()),
        Err(e) => Err(e),
    }
}

=== create src/controllers/items/destroy.rs
//! `POST /items/{id}/delete`: deleting a item.

use axum::{
    extract::{Path, State},
    response::{IntoResponse, Redirect, Response},
};

use crate::{
    error::AppError,
    kernel::flash::Flash,
    models::item,
    routes::paths,
    state::AppState,
};

/// `POST /items/{id}/delete`
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn destroy(
    State(s): State<AppState>,
    Path(id): Path<i64>,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    let record = item::find(&s.db, id).await?;
    item::destroy(&s.db, record).await?;
    Ok((
        Flash::notice("Item was successfully deleted."),
        Redirect::to(&paths::items()),
    )
        .into_response())
}

=== create src/views/items.rs
//! Page structs for items. Display values are computed here from loaded rows; no
//! database access (.offrails/structure.md). Generated by `cargo offrails generate resource items name:string notes:text? count:integer big:bigint flag:boolean active:boolean? weight:decimal{8.3} price:money at:datetime day:date? code:uuid:unique meta:json?`.

use askama::Template;

use super::Ctx;
use crate::models::{Errors, item};
use crate::routes::paths;

/// One item as pages show it: every value a display string.
/// APP: times are shown in UTC; convert to the reader's zone here when the app knows it.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ItemView {
    pub id: i64,
    pub label: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub notes: String,
    pub count: String,
    pub big: String,
    pub flag: String,
    pub active: String,
    pub weight: String,
    pub price_cents: String,
    pub at: String,
    pub day: String,
    pub code: String,
    pub meta: String,
}

impl ItemView {
    pub fn from_model(r: &item::Model) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: r.id,
            label: r.label(),
            name: r.name.clone(),
            notes: r.notes.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "—".to_owned()),
            count: r.count.to_string(),
            big: r.big.to_string(),
            flag: if r.flag { "Yes".to_owned() } else { "No".to_owned() },
            active: match r.active {
                Some(true) => "Yes".to_owned(),
                Some(false) => "No".to_owned(),
                None => "—".to_owned(),
            },
            weight: r.weight.round_dp(3).to_string(),
            price_cents: item::money_to_string(r.price_cents),
            at: r.at.format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC").to_string(),
            day: r.day.as_ref().map(|v| v.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string()).unwrap_or_else(|| "—".to_owned()),
            code: r.code.to_string(),
            meta: r.meta.as_ref().map(|v| v.to_string()).unwrap_or_else(|| "—".to_owned()),
        }
    }
}

/// `GET /items`
#[derive(Template)]
#[template(path = "items/index.html")]
pub struct ItemsIndex {
    pub ctx: Ctx,
    pub items: Vec<ItemView>,
    pub page: u64,
    pub more: bool,
}

impl ItemsIndex {
    /// The pagination component's page count: this one, and the next when the query found more
    /// (no COUNT query).
    pub fn pages(&self) -> u64 {
        self.page + u64::from(self.more)
    }

    /// Where its links go (`{base}page=n`).
    pub fn page_base(&self) -> String {
        format!("{}?", paths::items())
    }
}

/// `GET /items/{id}`
#[derive(Template)]
#[template(path = "items/show.html")]
pub struct ItemsShow {
    pub ctx: Ctx,
    pub item: ItemView,
}

/// `GET /items/new`, and a failed create (422).
#[derive(Template)]
#[template(path = "items/new.html")]
pub struct ItemsNew {
    pub ctx: Ctx,
    pub params: item::ItemParams,
    pub errors: Errors,
    pub action: String,
}

/// `GET /items/{id}/edit`, and a failed update (422).
#[derive(Template)]
#[template(path = "items/edit.html")]
pub struct ItemsEdit {
    pub ctx: Ctx,
    pub id: i64,
    pub params: item::ItemParams,
    pub errors: Errors,
    pub action: String,
}

=== create src/routes/items.rs
//! Items (`cargo offrails generate resource items`): its router, `paths::` helpers and `ROUTES` rows.
//! src/routes.rs wires it in with one `// items` line at `route mods`, `routes`, `paths`, `route tables`.

use axum::{Router, routing::{get, post}};

use super::{Access, Route};
use crate::state::AppState;

pub fn router() -> Router<AppState> {
    Router::new()
        .route("/items", get(crate::controllers::items::index).post(crate::controllers::items::create))
        .route("/items/new", get(crate::controllers::items::new))
        .route("/items/{id}", get(crate::controllers::items::show).post(crate::controllers::items::update))
        .route("/items/{id}/edit", get(crate::controllers::items::edit))
        .route("/items/{id}/delete", post(crate::controllers::items::destroy))
}

/// URL helpers; `crate::routes::paths` re-exports them.
pub mod paths {
    pub fn items() -> String {
        "/items".into()
    }

    pub fn new_item() -> String {
        "/items/new".into()
    }

    pub fn item(id: i64) -> String {
        format!("/items/{id}")
    }

    pub fn edit_item(id: i64) -> String {
        format!("/items/{id}/edit")
    }

    pub fn delete_item(id: i64) -> String {
        format!("/items/{id}/delete")
    }
}

#[rustfmt::skip]
pub const ROUTES: &[Route] = &[
    ("GET",  "/items",             "items::index",   Access::Public),
    ("GET",  "/items/new",         "items::new",     Access::Public),
    ("POST", "/items",             "items::create",  Access::Public),
    ("GET",  "/items/{id}",        "items::show",    Access::Public),
    ("GET",  "/items/{id}/edit",   "items::edit",    Access::Public),
    ("POST", "/items/{id}",        "items::update",  Access::Public),
    ("POST", "/items/{id}/delete", "items::destroy", Access::Public),
];

=== create tests/app/items/mod.rs
//! Items (src/controllers/items/): each action's happy path, validation.
//! Generated by `cargo offrails generate resource items name:string notes:text? count:integer big:bigint flag:boolean active:boolean? weight:decimal{8.3} price:money at:datetime day:date? code:uuid:unique meta:json?`.
//! APP: cite each acceptance criterion (`/// AC-items-1`) on the test that proves it
//! (.offrails/guides/test-standards.md#1-traceability-specs--tests).

mod read_test;
mod write_test;

use offrails_app::models::item;

use crate::support::{TestApp, TestResponse};

/// Submits `params` the way the form does.
async fn submit(app: &TestApp, path: &str, params: &item::ItemParams) -> TestResponse {
    let fields = [
        ("name", params.name.as_str()),
        ("notes", params.notes.as_str()),
        ("count", params.count.as_str()),
        ("big", params.big.as_str()),
        ("flag", params.flag.as_str()),
        ("active", params.active.as_str()),
        ("weight", params.weight.as_str()),
        ("price", params.price.as_str()),
        ("at", params.at.as_str()),
        ("day", params.day.as_str()),
        ("code", params.code.as_str()),
        ("meta", params.meta.as_str()),
    ];
    app.post_form(path, &fields).await
}

=== create tests/app/items/read_test.rs
//! Items: the list and one item. Generated by `cargo offrails generate resource items name:string notes:text? count:integer big:bigint flag:boolean active:boolean? weight:decimal{8.3} price:money at:datetime day:date? code:uuid:unique meta:json?`.

use axum::http::StatusCode;
use offrails_app::routes::paths;

use crate::factories;
use crate::support::TestApp;

#[tokio::test]
async fn index_lists_items() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let record = factories::item(app.db()).await;
    app.get(&paths::items())
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_text(&record.label());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn index_runs_the_same_queries_for_1_or_20_items() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    app.assert_query_count_stable(&paths::items(), async |count| {
        for _ in 0..count {
            factories::item(app.db()).await;
        }
    })
    .await;
}

/// A page past the last one (or a huge `?page=`) is an empty list, never a 500.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_page_past_the_end_is_empty() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    for page in ["2", "18446744073709551615"] {
        app.get(&format!("{}?page={page}", paths::items()))
            .await
            .assert_ok();
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn show_renders_a_item() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let record = factories::item(app.db()).await;
    app.get(&paths::item(record.id))
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_text(&record.label());
    app.get(&paths::item(record.id + 1000))
        .await
        .assert_status(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
}

=== create tests/app/items/write_test.rs
//! Items: the forms, saving, and deleting. Generated by `cargo offrails generate resource items name:string notes:text? count:integer big:bigint flag:boolean active:boolean? weight:decimal{8.3} price:money at:datetime day:date? code:uuid:unique meta:json?`.

use axum::http::StatusCode;
use offrails_app::models::item;
use offrails_app::routes::paths;

use super::submit;
use crate::factories;
use crate::support::TestApp;

#[tokio::test]
async fn new_renders_the_form() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    app.get(&paths::new_item())
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_contains(&format!("action=\"{}\"", paths::items()));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn create_saves_and_redirects_to_the_item() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let params = factories::item_params(app.db()).await;
    let res = submit(&app, &paths::items(), &params).await;
    let (rows, _) = item::all(app.db(), offrails_app::models::Page::default()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(rows.len(), 1, "one item saved");
    res.assert_redirect_to(&paths::item(rows[0].id));
    app.get(&paths::item(rows[0].id))
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_text("Item was successfully created.");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn create_with_invalid_params_is_422_with_the_errors_and_the_input() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let mut params = factories::item_params(app.db()).await;
    params.name = "".into();
    let res = submit(&app, &paths::items(), &params).await;
    res.assert_status(StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY)
        .assert_text("Name can't be blank");
    let (rows, _) = item::all(app.db(), offrails_app::models::Page::default()).await.unwrap();
    assert!(rows.is_empty(), "nothing saved");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn edit_shows_the_saved_values_and_update_saves_changes() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let record = factories::item(app.db()).await;
    app.get(&paths::edit_item(record.id))
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_contains(&format!("action=\"{}\"", paths::item(record.id)));
    let mut params = item::ItemParams::from(&record);
    params.name = "Changed by the test".into();
    submit(&app, &paths::item(record.id), &params)
        .await
        .assert_redirect_to(&paths::item(record.id));
    app.get(&paths::item(record.id))
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_text("Item was successfully updated.")
        .assert_text("Changed by the test");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn update_with_invalid_params_is_422_and_changes_nothing() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let record = factories::item(app.db()).await;
    let mut params = item::ItemParams::from(&record);
    params.name = "".into();
    submit(&app, &paths::item(record.id), &params)
        .await
        .assert_status(StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY)
        .assert_text("Name can't be blank");
    assert_eq!(factories::reload_item(app.db(), record.id).await, Some(record));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn destroy_deletes_and_redirects_to_the_list() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let record = factories::item(app.db()).await;
    app.post_form(&paths::delete_item(record.id), &[])
        .await
        .assert_redirect_to(&paths::items());
    assert!(factories::reload_item(app.db(), record.id).await.is_none());
    app.get(&paths::item(record.id))
        .await
        .assert_status(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn markup_in_a_item_is_shown_as_text() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let mut params = factories::item_params(app.db()).await;
    params.name = "<script>alert(1)</script>".into();
    let record = factories::item_with(app.db(), params).await;
    for path in [paths::items(), paths::item(record.id)] {
        app.get(&path)
            .await
            .assert_ok()
            .assert_not_contains("<script>alert(1)")
            .assert_text("<script>alert(1)</script>");
    }
}

mod items; // items
